g.title: SpottDFD
g.text: Repeated IDs represent the same entity or store. Arrows carry data.

g.title: cluster_reference_data
g.text: Mapped parking rules describe the area, not current spot availability.

g.title: cluster_discovery
g.text: Map, details, confidence and heatmap. Active search uses a fixed chosen circle.

g.text: Driver confirmation, cancellation, expiry and nearby occupancy checks.

g.title: cluster_driver_data
g.text: Private car positions are saved after driver confirmation.
